Frequently asked questions

How many Software Engineer jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 141 open Software Engineer jobs in the United States as of November 24, 2026.

How much do Software Engineer jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $81,087–$137,875 a year, based on 34 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Software Engineer jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include BOEING (17 listings), GovCIO (15 listings), Highmark Health (13 listings), Northrop Grumman (9 listings), and Revature (8 listings).

Do I need experience?

1 listings mention 0–2 years and 0 say no experience required. Other requirements vary; review the original posting. A title match alone does not confirm eligibility.
